test%20does%20not%20establish%20that%20a%20population%20is%20normal.%20With%20small%20samples%20it%20may%20have%20little%20power%3B%20with%20large%20samples%20it%20can%20detect%20departures%20too%20small%20to%20matter.%20The%20helper%E2%80%99s%20historical%20test-selection%20rule%20is%20an%20illustration%2C%20not%20a%20universal%20recipe%20for%20choosing%20an%20analysis.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Exercise%202.**%20One%20column%20contains%20%60%5B1%2C%202%2C%20NaN%2C%203%5D%60.%20How%20many%20observations%20support%20its%20mean%2C%20and%20what%20happens%20if%20NaN%20is%20replaced%20with%20zero%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%20details%20%7C%20Solution%20to%20Exercise%202%0A%20%20%20%20Three%20observations%20support%20the%20mean%2C%20%24(1%2B2%2B3)%2F3%3D2%24.%20Replacing%20the%20missing%20value%20with%20zero%20produces%20%246%2F4%3D1.5%24%20and%20invents%20a%20measurement.%20Report%20the%20available%20count%20as%20well%20as%20the%20mean.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Exercise%203.**%20If%20every%20observation%20is%20multiplied%20by%20100%20to%20convert%20metres%20to%20centimetres%2C%20how%20do%20mean%2C%20SD%2C%20and%20variance%20change%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%20details%20%7C%20Solution%20to%20Exercise%203%0A%20%20%20%20Mean%20and%20SD%20multiply%20by%20100%20because%20both%20have%20the%20data%E2%80%99s%20units.%20Variance%20multiplies%20by%20%24100%5E2%3D10%7B%2C%7D000%24%20because%20its%20units%20are%20squared.%20A%20change%20of%20units%20is%20not%20a%20change%20in%20variability%20relative%20to%20the%20mean.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20How%20the%20descriptive%20summary%20is%20computed%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(np)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22Descriptive%20statistics%20of%20data.%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20__author__%20%3D%20'Marcos%20Duarte%2C%20https%3A%2F%2Fgith 0%20%20%202.%20Dispersion%20of%20observations.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Within-person%20dependence%20changes%20the%20effective%20information%20and%20uncertainty.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Go%20deeper%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%5BConfidence%20and%20prediction%20intervals%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Fconfidence_prediction_intervals.py)%20%E2%80%94%20distinguish%20the%20spread%20of%20observations%20from%20uncertainty%20in%20a%20mean.%20%5BNIST%20statistical%20handbook%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fwww.itl.nist.gov%2Fdiv898%2Fhandbook%2F)%20%E2%80%94%20definitions%2C%20assumptions%2C%20and%20interpretation%20of%20statistical%20summaries.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Video%20lectures%20on%20the%20Internet%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%5BMIT%20Statistics%20for%20Applications%20lectures%5D(https%3A%2F%2Focw.mit.edu%2Fcourses%2F18-650-statistics-for-applications-fall-2016%2Fvideo_galleries%2Flecture-videos%2F)%20%E2%80%94%20use%20the%20lectures%20on%20estimation%20and%20confidence%20intervals%20to%20connect%20the%20numerical%20examples%20with%20repeated%20sampling.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20References%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20%5BNIST%20statistical%20handbook%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fwww.itl.nist.gov%2Fdiv898%2Fhandbook%2F)%20%E2%80%94%20definitions%2C%20assumptions%2C%20and%20interpretation%20of%20statistical%20summaries.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0Aif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%22__main__%22%3A%0A%20%20%20%20app.run()%0A
